projects.name: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
projects.description: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.
projects.description_zh: 开源自办的Slack替代程序 你的团队和AI智能体在频道和DM上合作 代理在克劳德,ChatGPT/Codex,双子座或格罗克运行,拥有MCP工具,自己的计算机和浏览器,常规,内存和批准. 网络,桌面和电话应用. 多克编曲 + Postgres. AGPL-3.0 (英语).
projects.reason: 近期创建，值得发现的新项目
